3967-7841--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Darksteel Angel
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2395-4508-7223-7863--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2395-4508-7223-7863--165.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcom triggers due to Stalactite Dagger, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Quicksmith Genius, causing you to draw a card and discard a card.
Repeat from step 2.
2395-4508-7223-7863--165.notes: You do not need the additional Hero creature if the changeling token created by Stalactite Dagger is still on the battlefield.

586-864-3125-5632-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5632-6495.description:
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Chalk Outline.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
586-864-3125-5632-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

851-6441-6664-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

670-1619-3742-6136.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6136.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Avenging Hunter until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Avenging Hunter to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Avenging Hunter until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

2169-2292--5.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6835-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2416-3899-4552-6774.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Rise and Shine
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-5663-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2034-5220-5631-6705-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-5631-6705-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

4083-4090-5488.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Indoraptor.
Indoraptor is indestructible.
4083-4090-5488.description:
Deal damage to Indoraptor.
Indoraptor and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Indoraptor trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Indoraptor instead of you due to Pariah.
Repeat from step 2.

1350-3390-3518-6751-6865.description:
Cast Astelli Reclaimer for its warp cost by paying {2}{W}.
When Astelli Reclaimer enters, it triggers twice, returning Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Astelli Raclaimer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1305-3480-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

942-2523-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted, adding {R}.
When Samwise the Stouthearted dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Samwise the Stouthearted that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Samwise the Stouthearted token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Samwise the Stouthearted token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

2793-3129-3743-5089-5437.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3129-3743-5089-5437.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1479-4677-5033.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-4677-5033.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

2440-2703-5223.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

4067-4395-5467.easyPrerequisites: Lightning Prowess attached to Wylie Duke.
4067-4395-5467.notablePrerequisites: Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
4067-4395-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Wylie Duke ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

4772-5115-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Gemstone Array.
4772-5115-5149.description:
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {1}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

227-1692-1965.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
"Spirit" or "Naga" chosen with Vanquisher's Banner.
227-1692-1965.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Omarthis with haste.
Put a +1/+1 counter on the Omarthis token or another colorless creature you control.
The nontoken Omarthis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
The Omarthis token triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 3.

147-1379-4819-5256.description:
Cast Triumphant Reckoning by paying {6}{W}{W}{W}.
In response, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Triumphant Reckoning.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing any player to mill two cards.
Resolve a copy of Triumphant Reckoning, returning all nonland permanent cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

282-3057-4706.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Vengeance attached to Delina.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
282-3057-4706.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, attacking any opponent unable to block and kill your creatures.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Bloodthirster that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage with the Bloodthirster token.
The Bloodthirster token triggers, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of the combat phase, the Bloodthirster token triggers, exiling itself.
Repeat.

628-1365-2292-4853.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Dross Scorpion persist until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dross Scorpion.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability, its undying ability and its persist ability.
Resolve the first Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dross Scorpion.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability and its undying ability.
Resolve the first Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the second Dross Scorpion trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dross Scorpion.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability and its persist ability.
Repeat from step 4.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 infinite times.

1211-1371-1499-1771.description:
Cast Mana Severance by paying {1}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Mana Severance.
Resolve each opponent's Mana Severance, searching their libraries for all land cards, exiling them and shuffling their library.
Resolve your Mana Severance, exiling no lands cards from your library and shuffling your library.
Cast Mind Grind by paying {1}{U}{B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Mind Grind.
Resolve each opponent's Mind Grind, revealing the rest of each opponent's library then put those cards into their graveyard.
Resolve your Mind Grind, revealing your cards until you reveal one land card from your library then puts all revealed cards to your graveyard.

1309-2104-3557.notablePrerequisites:
Brago does not have summoning sickness.
Brago can not be blocked.
1309-2104-3557.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Move to your combat phase.
Deal combat damage with Brago, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

413-1741-4766-5105.notablePrerequisites:
Deathrender attached to Cloud of Faeries.
You control lands that produce at least {1}{W}.
413-1741-4766-5105.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cloud of Faeries.
Sigil of the New Dawn and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Sigil of the New Dawn trigger, paying {1}{W} to return Cloud of Faeries from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Cloud of Faeries from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Cloud of Faeries and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping two lands you control that can produce {1}{W}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

739-3350-3591.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortality triggers.
Activate Necropotence by paying 1 life, exiling the top card of your library face down.
Repeat step 2 until you have zero life.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
